title: Homebrew formula drift is not caught by CI
description: Evidence: release:brew:verify exists but the PR workflow does not run it; the formula hard-codes npm tarball URL/SHA, and the release package test checks URL/version shape but not SHA against the packed artifact. Impact: version or dist changes can pass CI while brew install fails after npm publish due stale sha256.
acceptanceCriteria: A CI-safe formula consistency check compares formula version, URL, and sha256 to the current packed npm tarball.
The formula consistency check runs before npm dry-run or is otherwise enforced in release gating.
